python_ref: Python loop over batch, per-trajectory inner backward recurrence (not NumPy-vectorizable)
notes: GAE's backward recurrence is the canonical example of a Python-loop-dominated kernel where Rust's advantage compounds with batch size. For vectorizable kernels (e.g. plain group-mean normalization), NumPy/BLAS is competitive with Rust at typical batch sizes — the Rust core is included for the recurrence-heavy paths, not as a blanket speedup over NumPy.
